subject: Re: Air freight quote to NRT
body:
Thank you for your offer, we would like to give this shipment to you. Before I confirm: another forwarder has offered us the same shipment 7% cheaper. Can you match that? Please let me know where your price stands.

Mira Petersen
Nordlicht Audio

classification.reasoning: The customer expresses interest but asks whether TALOS can match a cheaper offer before confirming, so they have not yet accepted.
